job.title: E-commerce Data Scraping & Dashboard Development
job.description: We are looking for a professional who can automate the collection of e-commerce sales data and present it through a user-friendly, interactive dashboard. The work involves designing a scraping solution, processing and structuring the dataset, and building a visual reporting tool in Power BI or Excel. The outcome should allow our team to monitor revenue, profit, customer segments, and product performance at a glance enabling faster and smarter decision-making.

data_collection: Build an automated scraper with Selenium, BeautifulSoup + WebDriver
Capture details including Transaction Date, Buyer Name, Location (State/Region), Category & Sub-Category, Units Sold, Sales Value, Profit Margin, Payment Type
data_preparation: Standardize categories, product names, and regional entries
Ensure uniform formatting for dates, currency, and numbers
Provide a clean dataset in CSV/Excel format
analytics_insights: Compute key business indicators: Gross Sales, Profit & Margins
dashboard_reporting: Create an interactive reporting dashboard in Power BI or Excel
Features: Dynamic filters (time, category, payment method)
Visualizations: Sales by State/Customer (bar chart), Category & Payment breakdown (pie chart), Monthly Profit (column chart), Sub-Category Profit (bar chart)

skills_competencies: Web Automation & Scraping: Selenium, BeautifulSoup, WebDriver
Data Processing in Python: Pandas, NumPy
Business Intelligence Tools: Power BI, Excel (advanced visualization)
Ability to translate raw data into clear business insights
application_guidelines: Share an example of a previous project combining data scraping with dashboard/reporting
Bonus if the example is related to e-commerce or sales analysis

proposal.text:
Hi,

I understand how important it is for you to have real-time visibility into sales performance without getting stuck in manual data collection. I’ve delivered similar projects before — for example, I built an end-to-end ETL pipeline for Jumia (extract, transform, load with scraping + sentiment analysis) and developed an Amazon sales dashboard that allowed instant tracking of KPIs like revenue, product performance, and profit margins.

Here’s how I’d approach your project:

🔹 Data Collection & Automation
Build a reliable scraper using Selenium + BeautifulSoup to capture all required fields (transaction date, buyer, location, sales value, margins, etc.).
Configure it for scheduled execution (daily/weekly) so your team always works with fresh data.

🔹 Data Cleaning & Preparation
Standardize product categories, regions, and currency/date formats.
Deliver a clean, structured dataset in CSV/Excel, ready for analytics.

🔹 Insights & Dashboards
Create a Power BI (or Excel) dashboard with dynamic filters and interactive visuals:
Sales by state/customer
Category & payment method breakdown
Monthly profit trends
Sub-category profit drilldowns
Ensure metrics like gross sales and margins are front and center for quick decision-making.

Why me?
Experience combining scraping + analytics + visualization into one smooth solution.
Strong background in Python (Pandas, NumPy), SQL, and BI tools.
Proven results in e-commerce analytics — I know the challenges of messy data and how to transform it into insights.

Since this is urgent, I can prepare a working sample with a small dataset within 2–3 days so you can validate the approach before scaling.

👉 Shall we start with a quick call to finalize the KPIs and dashboard design you’d like prioritized?

Best regards,
Adiel
